advice_items.quote: Take a risk that other people won't take that might fail, but if you win, you win huge... make sure that you can play again.
advice_items.summary_en: Burn the boats early and take bold risks others avoid, while ensuring you can survive failure and play again.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢冒他人不敢冒的风险，确保失败后仍能重新再来

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: I knew what strategic game I was playing... doing software things within Silicon Valley was a very good place to be doing it.
advice_items.summary_en: Pick the right strategic arena and geographic ecosystem, such as software in Silicon Valley or AI accelerating physical industries.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对核心赛道与产业集群，顺应时代技术浪潮

advice_items.quote: More than two-thirds of my smart friends thought I was going to be a complete failure... What do I know that they don't know?
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be deterred when smart peers predict failure; invite critique to test what contrarian insight you hold that others miss.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无视多数人唱衰，问自己掌握了什么别人不懂的真相

advice_items.quote: The key thing is think what you can give someone. So what's something that you could do that would help them?
advice_items.summary_en: Build genuine relationships by leading with what useful insight or help you can offer someone, rather than asking for favors.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人脉核心是先思考能为对方提供什么价值，而非索取

advice_items.quote: One is curiosity. So, like intensely wanting to learn.
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate intense curiosity and a relentless desire to learn, a core trait shared by the top 0.001% of successful people.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顶级成功者都具备强烈的好奇心与持续学习的渴望

advice_items.quote: Another one is just raw grit and you know like I am going to make this work.
advice_items.summary_en: Develop raw grit and unyielding determination to push through obstacles and make your venture work.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拥有“无论如何都要把事情做成”的原始韧劲与毅力

advice_items.quote: Companies are bought not sold. So, if you're selling, you have a problem. You want them to come in and buy you.
advice_items.summary_en: In M&A and deal-making, shift the power dynamic so buyers or investors pursue you rather than you desperately pitching them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 公司是被买家主动收购的，而非靠卖家低姿态推销

advice_items.quote: When you make the decision, you've chosen door A, not door B, but it's the only way you get opportunity in the long term.
advice_items.summary_en: Commit decisively to one path (door A over door B); narrowing short-term options is the only way to unlock long-term opportunity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 果断选择一扇门并放弃备选，才能换取长期大机会

advice_items.quote: I'm playing a multi-time game. And I'm expecting that I'm going to fail along the way some... celebrate learning in order to win.
advice_items.summary_en: Treat entrepreneurship as a multi-round game where setbacks are expected—celebrate learning in order to win rather than glorifying failure.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把创业当多次博弈，坦然面对挫折并从学习中获胜

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: You need to go prove your credentials at launching products first... I actually went and ended up working at Apple Computer.
advice_items.summary_en: Before trying to raise capital without a track record, work at a strong company to prove you can launch products and build a network.
advice_items.summary_zh: 融资前先去优秀企业推出产品，证明战绩并积累人脉

advice_items.quote: Investors, they invest in people and they invest in businesses, not ideas... why would they take a bet on you?
advice_items.summary_en: VCs say yes to only 0–2 of 600–800 deals a year; pitch a massive current trend with a sharp, unmistakable reason why they should bet on you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资人投的是人和大趋势，要给出非你不可的理由

advice_items.quote: How do I make decisions in a way that I do not take my foot off the accelerator? ... Not ever slowing down.
advice_items.summary_en: When blitzscaling into a large market, make product, market, and hiring decisions at full speed without taking your foot off the accelerator.
advice_items.summary_zh: 闪电式扩张核心是在全速前进中做决策，绝不踩刹车

advice_items.quote: The things that's most important to hire or partner with are the people who add their strengths against your weaknesses.
advice_items.summary_en: Life is a team sport—hire and partner with people whose operational strengths directly complement your weaknesses.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人生是团队运动，招募能力能互补你短板的合伙人

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: The companies are coming to us... make a slide deck... the sales guy came back with purchase orders and we're like okay we're building that product.
advice_items.summary_en: Listen to market pull and pivot when customers show up—validate demand with a pitch deck and purchase orders before building.
advice_items.summary_zh: 顺应客户主动求购需求及时转型，先拿订单再做产品

advice_items.quote: I almost never play a one-year game. I play a 10-year game... compounding to 10 years is one of the things that gives a differential edge.
advice_items.summary_en: Think in decades rather than one-year horizons; long-term compounding over 10 years creates a decisive competitive edge most people miss.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拒绝一年期短视思维，坚持十年长线复利以建立壁垒

advice_items.quote: Building a network and getting growth in the network and then monetization could come later.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus first on growing the network and reaching critical scale; monetization and the business model can be built on top afterward.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先全力做大网络效应与增长，变现模式可随后建立

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身公务员家庭，斯坦福AI专业毕业后先在苹果、富士通工作积累产品与人脉；随后创办首家公司Social（虽未成功但进入创业轨道），核心参与PayPal（15亿美元被eBay收购），并在2003年创立LinkedIn，最终以260亿美元售予微软（约38岁成为亿万富翁）。
guests.role_or_title: Co-founder of LinkedIn, VC & AI Startup Co-founder (Former PayPal Executive)
guests.wealth_detail: Sold LinkedIn to Microsoft for $26B (LinkedIn $16B annual revenue); PayPal acquired by eBay for $1.5B; became a billionaire around age 38
guests.zero_start_advice: 做与大多数人截然不同的事情；不玩一年期短线游戏，而是以10年为单位进行长远复利思考（例如创办AI抗癌新药研发公司），通过长期积累实现改变行业的颠覆性成果。
